pages.title: Ore Detector
pages.text: Two Heavy Cores, three Breeze Rods and a comparator. One detector replaces the eleven separate vanilla ore detectors the mod used to have.

pages.title: Scanning
pages.text: Right click a $(thing)surface$() with it in your $(thing)main hand$(). The beam fires straight into that face and reports what it finds in the action bar, tinted per ore.$(br2)It costs $(thing)1 durability$() a scan whatever it finds, and $(thing)1 mB$() of that ore's liquid for every block found.

pages.title: Two pools
pages.text: $(thing)Durability$() is 1000 and is mechanical wear. A Breeze Shard in an anvil restores 250.$(br2)$(thing)Liquid$() is the tank, 750 mB, three bottles. Hover the detector to see what is loaded and how far it reaches.$(br2)Running dry does not break it. The tank simply stops answering for that ore.
